source: SEC EDGAR, Polestar filing, Exhibit 10.9 (d239003dex109.htm): Car Model Assignment and License Agreement between Volvo Car Corporation and Polestar Performance AB, with a side letter and a 2021 amendment
notes: Three documents in one PDF: the main agreement (pages 3-8), a side letter (pages 15-18) and an amendment (pages 19-22). Each restarts at section 1.

Numbered lines that are only headings (1. DEFINITIONS, 5.4 Design and Patent rights, 5.4.2 Warranties...) are not listed, because the splitter turns a heading into the heading of the clauses under it.
Side letter 2.4 is left out: its whole text is redacted to a bullet and [***].

known_failures.numbers: The table of contents on page 2 sets the section counter to 8, so sections 1-8 of the main agreement are rejected as out of order. The side letter leaves the counter at 7, and AMENDMENT AGREEMENT does not reset it, so the amendment's sections are rejected too.
known_failures.headings: Main-agreement 7 and 8 are matched to the table of contents lines on page 2: 7 has no heading and 8's heading keeps the page number ('TERM AND TERMINATION 5'). Once the real sections are found, is_title may also reject headings with lowercase words, such as 5.2 'Grant-back license to Common Polestar Technology'.
known_failures.pages: Main-agreement 7 and 8 come from the table of contents on page 2. Side letter 2.1 and 6 run onto the next page because the page numbers 2(5) and 3(5) are not blanked, and 7.2 runs into the signature page.
known_failures.not_in_clause_text: Running headers such as 'Car Model Assignment and License Agreement 1(6)' and page numbers such as 2(5) are not blanked.
